info.title: Lazy CRUD command line
info.description: Lazy CRUD for Visual Studio, unattended. Generates and maintains aggregates from the Lazy CRUD platform's templates, protecting files you have changed. The same engine the Visual Studio extension uses, so a build server and a developer produce the same result. Generation requires an installed Visual Studio with the Text Template Transformation component.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: lazycrud 1.1.0 - Lazy CRUD for Visual Studio, unattended. Generation requires an installed Visual Studio with the Text Template Transformation component.

commands.name: init-sln
commands.description: Initialize a solution ready for Lazy CRUD aggregates.

options.name: --path
options.description: Target directory for the new solution (default: the current directory).

options.name: --name
options.description: Solution name (default: the directory name).

options.name: --templates
options.description: Template source: nuget, local, or local:<directory> (default: lazy.settings).

options.name: --platform-version
options.description: Version pinned for the Lazy CRUD platform packages of aggregates created later.

options.name: --feed
options.description: Additional NuGet feed (folder or URL) written into nuget.config; repeatable.

options.name: --clean-room
options.description: Clear inherited feeds, isolate the package cache and forbid the local template fallback.

options.name: --packages-folder
options.description: Isolated NuGet global-packages folder (clean room).

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite drifted or unverified generator-owned files, reporting each overwrite.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report the plan without modifying anything.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and log lines.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the structured result as a single JSON document on stdout; all logging goes to stderr.

commands.name: create-aggregate
commands.description: Create an aggregate: scaffold its projects, register it and generate its code.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the .sln file or the solution directory (default: discovered from the current directory).

options.name: --agg
options.description: Aggregate name.

options.name: --context
options.description: Namespace prefix of the aggregate's projects.

options.name: --entity
options.description: Name of the aggregate root entity (default: the aggregate name).

options.name: --settings
options.description: Path to the lazy.settings file to use (exactly this file; discovery is not used).

options.name: --descriptor
options.description: Path to a platform descriptor (lazycrud.platform.json) to use instead of the installed packages.

options.name: --templates
options.description: Template source: nuget, local, or local:<directory> (default: lazy.settings).

options.name: --platform-version
options.description: Version pinned for the Lazy CRUD platform package references of scaffolded projects (default: lazy.settings, then the resolved platform).

options.name: --vs-instance
options.description: Installation path of the Visual Studio instance to use for template transformation.

options.name: --no-generate
options.description: Scaffold the projects without running the generation.

options.name: --no-tests
options.description: Do not scaffold or transform the aggregate's test projects.

options.name: --skip-restore
options.description: Skip the package restore before and after generation (for a solution already restored).

options.name: --max-parallel
options.description: Maximum number of non-Domain layers transformed in parallel (default: lazy.settings).
